description: This file defines the implementation of the ConstantUnion class used for constant folding and type operations within the ANGLE project's shader translator component.

classes.name: TConstantUnion
classes.description: Represents a constant value with type information, supporting various operations and conversions.

methods.name: getIConst
methods.description: Returns the integer constant value, asserting the type is EbtInt.

methods.name: getUConst
methods.description: Returns the unsigned integer constant value, asserting the type is EbtUInt.

methods.name: getFConst
methods.description: Returns the float constant value, converting from int or uint if necessary.

methods.name: cast
methods.description: Casts the constant to a new type, updating its value accordingly.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison with int, uint, float, bool, or another TConstantUnion.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison with int, uint, float, bool, or another TConstantUnion.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Performs constant addition with type handling and diagnostics.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Performs constant subtraction with type handling and diagnostics.

methods.name: mul
methods.description: Performs constant multiplication with type handling and diagnostics.

methods.name: rshift
methods.description: Performs right shift with sign extension for signed integers.

methods.name: lshift
methods.description: Performs left shift with type casting for bit pattern interpretation.
